{{otheruses|the precursor weapon for Sunrise|the time of day|Day and night|the sylvari cycle|Cycle|the zephyrite NPC|Dawn (NPC)}} {{Weapon infobox | description = {{flavor|This weapon is used to craft the legendary greatsword [[Sunrise]].

Combine this weapon in the Mystic Forge with:
• 1 Gift of Sunrise
• 1 Gift of Mastery
• 1 Gift of Fortune}} | type = Greatsword | level = 80 | rarity = exotic | collection = Legendary Weapon: Sunrise | prefix = berserker | uslot = Superior Sigil of Rage | bound = use | salvage = none | skin = Dawn (skin); Khrysaor, the Golden Sword (skin); Dawn Experiment (skin) | set = Precursor weapons | id = 29169 }} [[Dawn]] is an [[exotic]] level 80 [[greatsword]] and the [[precursor weapon]] for [[Sunrise]]. == Acquisition == === Recipe === * Crafted once per account after completing the [[Sunrise III: Dawn]] collection. {{recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Box of Recipes: Dawn | type = Legendary Component | disciplines = Weaponsmith | rating = 500 | ingredient1 = 1 Essence of Illumination | ingredient2 = 1 Spirit of the Perfected Daysword | ingredient3 = 1 Mirror (item) | ingredient4 = 1 Dimensional Destabilizer | id = 11390 }} === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Other === {{exotic weapon text}} == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Notes == * The [[Game_updates/2019-06-25|June 25th, 2019]] update added a [[Holographic Dawn|holographic version of this weapon]] to the game. ** As [[Dusk]] is nearly identical to '''Dawn''', there is no holographic version of the former. == Trivia == * A [[Bringer's Wrapped Greatsword|"gift-wrapped" version]] of this skin can be found as part of the [[Wrapped weapons]] set.
